close_reason: added batch_destroy_emails to MailBackend trait with default loop impl; MemoryBackend overrides with single-lock batch; mailbox.rs uses it
description: handle_mailbox_set calls destroy_object once per email when onDestroyRemoveEmails=true. For a mailbox with M emails this is M+2 backend calls. The MailBackend trait needs a batch_destroy_emails method to let backends do this in one operation. Until added, large mailbox destroys will be catastrophically slow with any real backend. Source: JMAP-bx3z.1 review finding.
title: MailBackend: add batch_destroy_emails to avoid O(n) calls on onDestroyRemoveEmails
